meta.titre: The third conditional: unreal hypotheses about the past

sections.contenu_markdown: The third conditional imagines a different past: 'if only I had done things differently...'
If + past perfect, ... would have + past participle. This structure expresses an unreal, imagined alternative to something that actually happened in the past.
sections.formule_principale: If + past perfect, ... would have + past participle

sections.enonce_markdown: Match: 'I wouldn't have had these terrible skin problems...' with its condition.

etapes.action: Match with a past perfect condition
etapes.justification: 'if I hadn't been bitten' fits the pattern.
etapes.resultat_markdown: if I hadn't been bitten by black flies

sections.conclusion_markdown: I wouldn't have had these terrible skin problems if I hadn't been bitten by black flies.

items.erreur_markdown: Matching a third conditional result with a present or future condition.
items.pourquoi_faux: Third conditional clauses must both refer to an imagined alternative past, not the present or future.
items.correction_markdown: Always match 'would have + past participle' only with an 'if + past perfect' condition.

items.enonce_markdown: Complete: If she had studied harder, she ... (pass) the exam.

items_markdown: Third conditional = If + past perfect, would have + past participle
Used for unreal, imagined alternatives to the past
